zh: 当天两个人就到了上海，住在裕记丝栈。古应春得信赶来相会。见了胡雪岩略有忸怩之色，他自然不会在那样的场合之下提到七姑奶奶，先听取古应春谈上海的市面，丝价是涨了，由于庞二的支持，大家都齐心一致，待价而沽，但洋人似乎也很厉害，千方百计，自己到内地去收丝，辗转运到上海集中放洋。“这局面当然不会长的，第一，费事，第二，成本不轻，第三，两江总督衙门等出了告示，为了维持威信，各处关卡，自然要派兵盘查，严禁闯关。照我看，“古应春很兴奋地说，”洋人快要就范了。你来得正是时候。“
en: The two men reached Shanghai that same day and took rooms at Yuji Silk Warehouse. Gu Yingchun hurried over when he heard they had arrived. He looked slightly embarrassed on seeing Hu Xueyan, who naturally would not mention the Seventh Lady in such circumstances. First he listened to Gu's account of the Shanghai market. Silk prices had risen. With Pang Er's support, everyone was holding together and waiting for a satisfactory price. But the foreigners, too, seemed formidable. By every means they could devise, they went inland to buy silk themselves, brought it by roundabout routes to Shanghai, and assembled it for shipment overseas. “This cannot last,” Gu said excitedly. “First, it's troublesome; second, it costs a good deal; third, once the Liangjiang governor-general's yamen has issued its proclamation, it must uphold its authority. Naturally, troops will be stationed at the checkpoints to inspect shipments and prevent anyone forcing a passage. In my view, the foreigners will soon have to come to terms. You've arrived at exactly the right time.”

zh: 胡雪岩听此报告，自感欣慰。不过此行要办的事极多，得分缓急先后，一样一样来办。首先要打听的就是何桂清的下落。“这就不晓得了！”古应春说，“学台是要到各府各州去岁考秀才的，此刻不知道在哪里。不过总打听得到的。这件事交给我。”“不光是打听，有封紧要信要专人送去。”“这也好办。你把信交给我好了。”这件事有了交代，第二件就得谈浙江要买洋枪的事。古应春在由接到胡雪岩的信以后，已经作过初步联络，只是那个洋人到宁波去了，还得几天才能回上海，唯有暂且等待。
en: The report pleased Hu. Yet he had so much to do on this journey that he must put his business in order of urgency and attend to it item by item. His first question concerned He Guiqing's whereabouts. “That I don't know,” Gu said. “The provincial education commissioner has to visit the prefectures and departments to conduct the regular examinations of licentiates. I don't know where he is just now, but we can certainly find out. Leave that to me.” “It isn't only finding him. There's an important letter to be delivered by a special messenger.” “That can be arranged too. Give me the letter.” With this settled, they turned to Zhejiang's gun purchase. Since receiving Hu's letter, Gu had made preliminary inquiries, but the foreign merchant had gone to Ningbo and would not return to Shanghai for several days. They could only wait.

zh: 最急要的两件事谈过，那就该谈七姑奶奶了。在路上，胡雪岩就已跟尤五商量好，到此辰光，须得回避，所以一个眼色抛过去，尤五便托词去找朋友，站起身来，准备出门。“五哥，”古应春说，“我替老胡接风，一起吃番菜去。”“番菜有啥好吃？动刀动叉的，我也嫌麻烦，你们去吧！”目送他的背影消失，胡雪岩便笑道：“老古，你瞒得我好！”这一说，古应春立刻不着急了，“你是说七姐的事？如果我有心瞒你，就是我不够朋友。”他有些气急败坏地，“如果你也不谅解我，我就没有路好走了！”“不要急，不要急！你慢慢的说给我听，大家一想想办法。我就不相信做不成这头媒。”听得这两句话，古应春大感宽慰，“我就是怕信里说不清楚，又想你不久就要来了，所以索性不说。原是要等你来替我做个军师。”古应春说，“这件事搞成这么一个地步，你不晓得我心里的着急。真好有一比……”他咽着唾沫说不下去了。“好比什么？”胡雪岩问道：“你作个比方，我就晓得你的难处在什么地方？”“我好比‘鬼打墙’，不知道怎么一下，会弄成了这个样子？”
en: The two most urgent matters discussed, it was time to speak of the Seventh Lady. Hu had agreed with You Laowu on the journey that You must withdraw at this point. At a glance from Hu, he rose, saying that he had a friend to see. “Brother Five,” Gu said, “I'm giving Hu a welcome dinner. Come and have foreign food with us.” “What's so good about foreign food? All those knives and forks—I can't be bothered. You go.” As his figure disappeared, Hu smiled. “You've kept me nicely in the dark, Old Gu!” At this, Gu became agitated. “You mean Seventh Sister? If I'd deliberately concealed it, I wouldn't deserve to be called your friend. If even you won't understand me, I'll have nowhere left to turn!” “Don't get excited. Tell me slowly, and we'll think of something together. I refuse to believe I can't make this match.” These words greatly reassured Gu. “I was afraid I couldn't explain it properly in a letter, and I knew you'd be coming soon, so I decided to say nothing. I was waiting for you to act as my strategist. You don't know how anxious I am, with the affair in this state. It's just like...” He swallowed and could not finish. “Like what? Give me an image, and I'll understand where your difficulty lies.” “Like being trapped behind a wall raised by ghosts. I can't understand how I suddenly found myself in this predicament.”

zh: 胡雪岩笑着说，“酒能乱性，又碰着一向喜欢的人，生米下了锅，却又煮不成熟饭，实在急人！”“对，对！”古应春抚掌称妙，“你这个比方真好。我和你说句心里的话，到了她那里，馋在眼里，饿在肚里，就是到不了嘴里，就为的是煮不成熟饭！”“怎么？真的从那晚以后，就跟七姐没有‘好’过？”胡雪岩想到尤五的话，说是七姑奶奶告诉过他，古应春从来没有在她那里留宿过一夜，如今又听他本人这样表示，心里不免存疑。男人的脾气他是知道的，七姑奶奶又是豪放脱略，什么都不在乎的性格，既有那一夜的“好事”，何以鸳鸯未续，似乎不近情理。彼此极熟，无话不谈，论及闺阁，虽伤口德，但以七姑奶奶的情形不同，也不算“唐突佳人”，于是胡雪岩便笑道：“干柴烈火，就只烧过那么一回，这倒有点奇怪了！”
en: Hu laughed. “Wine overcomes restraint, and there you were with someone you'd always liked. The raw rice has gone into the pot, yet you can't cook it into a proper meal. No wonder you're anxious!” “Exactly!” Gu clapped his hands. “A perfect comparison. To tell you honestly, when I go to her, my eyes feast and my stomach hungers, but nothing reaches my mouth—all because the rice cannot be cooked!” “What? You really haven't been intimate with Seventh Sister since that night?” Hu remembered You's account: she had told her brother that Gu had never spent a night at her place. Now Gu himself said much the same, and Hu could not help doubting it. He knew men's habits. The Seventh Lady, moreover, was bold, unconventional and careless of restraint. After that night's happy encounter, why had the lovers not come together again? It hardly seemed reasonable. He and Gu were close enough to discuss anything. To speak of bedroom matters might be indiscreet, but given the Seventh Lady's unusual circumstances, it was hardly an affront to her. He smiled. “Dry wood and a blazing fire, yet they burned only once? That's rather curious.”

zh: “说破了，你就不觉得奇怪，我是为了两层原因：第一，既然打算明媒正娶，该当尊重七姐，那一夜就如你所说的，‘酒能乱性’，另当别论，第二，婚事还有周折，后果如何，颇难逆料，倘或不成，且不说对不起七姐跟五哥，就是我自己良心上亦不安。再有那不明内情的人，一定说我始乱终弃，洋场上好说闲话的人最多，如果我有这么一个名声落在外面，那就不知道让人说得我如何不堪了！”此言一出，胡雪岩肃然起敬，“老古，”他收敛了笑容，说了句使古应春深感安慰的话：“照你这样的存心，姻缘也不会不成。时候还早，我先去看看七姐。”
en: “Once I explain, you won't think it curious. There are two reasons. First, since I intend to marry her formally as my wife, I ought to show her respect. That night was a different matter—as you said, wine overcame restraint. Second, the marriage still faces obstacles, and no one can predict the outcome. If it fails, I'd have wronged both her and Brother Five, quite apart from what my conscience would say. People who didn't know the circumstances would accuse me of seducing and abandoning her. The foreign settlement is full of gossips. With a reputation like that, who knows what a villain they'd make of me!” Hu's respect rose at these words. His smile disappeared. “Old Gu, with intentions like yours, this marriage cannot fail. It's still early. I'll go and see Seventh Sister first.” Gu found this profoundly comforting.

zh: 古应春略一沉吟，这样答道：“那就索性到她那里去吃饭。今天家里还有点菜。”这样的语气，显得古应春跟七姑奶奶已经象夫妇一样，只欠同圆好梦而已。同时也听得出他和她的感情很不坏。一双两好，顺理成章的事，偏有那个“程咬金”来讲家法，真正可恨！胡雪岩起了种不服气的心思，当即拍胸说道：“老古，你放心！你们那位老族长，看我来对付他。”“慢来，老胡！”古应春惴惴然地说：“那是我的一位叔祖，又教先父念过书，你千万不可鲁莽，你倒说说看，是如何‘对付’？”“ ‘对付，这两个字，好象不大好听。其实我不是想办法叫他’吃瘪‘，是想办法叫他服贴。”“那就对了。”古应春欣然问道。“你快说来听听，让我也好高兴高兴！”“此刻还不到高兴的时候，只好说是放心。事情要做起来看，办法倒有一个，不过要我先跟七姐谈了再说。”“啥时候谈？要不要我回避？”“能回避最好。”“那样这样，我陪你去了以后，我到外国伙食店去买些野味，你就在那里谈好了。”
en: After a moment's thought, Gu answered, “Then let's have dinner at her place. There's still some food at home today.” His tone made it clear that he and the Seventh Lady were already like husband and wife, lacking only the fulfilment of their shared dream. Their affection was plainly strong. Here were two people perfectly suited to one another, a match that ought to follow naturally, and that meddling Cheng Yaojin had to appear, brandishing clan rules. Infuriating! Hu felt a surge of defiance. Striking his chest, he declared, “Don't worry, Old Gu. Leave that old clan head to me.” “Wait, Hu!” Gu said nervously. “He's a great-uncle of mine, and he taught my late father. You mustn't act rashly. Tell me, how do you propose to ‘deal with’ him?” “‘Deal with’ may sound rather unpleasant. I'm not trying to make him lose face. I'm trying to win his consent.” “That's right.” Gu brightened. “Tell me quickly, so I can share the pleasure.” “It isn't time for pleasure yet, only reassurance. We must see how things work out. I do have a plan, but I must speak to Seventh Sister first.” “When? Should I keep out of the way?” “That would be best.” “Then I'll take you there and go to a foreign provision shop to buy some game. You can talk while I'm out.”

zh: 这样约定以后，古应春便雇了一辆“亨斯美”的马车，到了棋盘街七姑奶奶的寓所。一见面，七姑奶奶喜不自胜，“小爷叔，”她说，“昨天晚上老古去了以后，我起牙牌，算定今天有贵人到，果不其然你来了！真正救命王菩萨！”接着又瞟着古应春说：“那是他们的姓不好！遇着这么一个牛脾气的老‘古’板，真把我气得胃气都要发了。”“不要气，不要气！只要你肯听我的话，包你也姓古！”听得这话，古应春便站起身来，依照预先商量好的步骤，托词到洋人伙食店去买野味，离座而去。等他一走，七姑奶奶的态度便不同了，在古应春面前，她因为性子好强，表示得毫不在乎，而此时与胡雪岩单独相处，就象真的遇见了亲叔叔似地，满脸委屈、凄惶，与她平常豪迈脱略的神态比较，令人不能相信是同一个人。“小爷叔，”她用微带哭音的声调说，“你看我，不上不下怎么办？一辈子要争气，偏偏搞出这么件争不出气的事！所以我不大回松江，实实在在是没脸见人。小爷叔，你无论如何要替我想想办法。”“你不要急！办法一定有。”胡雪岩很谨慎地问道，“事情我要弄清楚，到底是你们感情好得分不开，还是为了争面子？”“两样都有！”七姑奶奶答道，“讲到面子，总是女人吃亏。唉！也怪我自己不好，耍花枪耍得自己扎伤了自己。”
en: Having agreed, Gu hired a “Hengsimei” carriage and took Hu to the Seventh Lady's lodgings in Qipan Street. She was overjoyed to see him. “Little Uncle, after Gu left last night, I cast the dominoes and divined that an honoured helper would come today. Sure enough, here you are! A bodhisattva come to save my life!” Then she glanced at Gu. “It's that unfortunate surname of theirs. We had to come up against a stubborn old Gu—a hidebound old stick! He's made me so angry my stomach's nearly acting up.” “Don't be angry. So long as you'll listen to me, I guarantee you'll be called Gu yourself.” At this, Gu rose and, following their agreed plan, excused himself to buy game at the foreign provision shop. Once he had gone, her manner changed. Her pride made her pretend indifference in front of Gu. Alone with Hu, however, she behaved as though she had truly found an uncle of her own. Her face was full of hurt and distress. Compared with her usual bold, carefree manner, it scarcely seemed the same person. “Little Uncle,” she said, her voice close to tears, “what am I to do, left hanging like this? All my life I've tried to hold my head high, and now I've landed myself in something I can't hold my head high about. That's why I seldom go back to Songjiang. I really can't face people. You must find some way to help me.” “Don't worry. There must be a way.” Hu asked carefully, “But I must understand. Is it that you love each other too much to part, or that your pride is involved?” “Both. When it comes to reputation, it's always the woman who suffers. Ah, I have myself to blame. I tried a fancy trick with a spear and wounded myself.”

zh: 胡雪岩最善于听人的语气，入耳便觉话外有话，随即问道：“你耍的什么花枪？”问到这话，她的表情非常奇怪，好笑、得意、害羞而又失悔，混杂在一起，连胡雪岩那样精于鉴貌辩色的人，都猜不透她葫芦里究竟卖的什么药？“怎么？”胡雪岩故意反激一句，“说不出口就算了！”“话是说得出口的，只怕……只怕小爷叔不相信。”“这一点你不用管。不是我吹一句，别样本事没有，人家说话，是真是假？真到几成帐，假到什么速度，都瞒不过我。”“这我倒相信。”七姑奶奶的表情又一变，变得诚恳了，“这话呢，实在要跟小爷叔才能说，连我五嫂那里，我都不肯说的。说了，她一定埋怨我，我倒先问小爷叔，外头怎么说我？”“外头？哪里有外头！我只听五哥告诉过我。”“他怎么说呢？”“酒能乱性”之类的话，怎么说得出口？胡雪岩想了想，这样答道：“五哥说，这件事不怪老古。”话虽含蓄，七姑奶奶一听就明白，“自然是怪我！好象自轻自贱，天在上头，”她说“实实在在没有那回事！”“没有哪回事？”胡雪岩愕然。
en: Hu was exceptionally good at reading a person's tone. At once he sensed more behind her words. “What trick did you play?” Her expression became extraordinary: amusement, pride, shame and regret mingled in it. Even Hu, so practised at reading faces, could not guess what she had in mind. “Well?” he deliberately provoked her. “If you can't bring yourself to say it, never mind.” “I can say it. I'm only afraid... afraid you won't believe me.” “Leave that to me. Not to boast, but whatever else I can't do, I can tell when people speak the truth or lie, how much of the truth they tell and how far their falsehood goes. None of that escapes me.” “I believe that.” Her expression changed again, becoming earnest. “You're the only person I could tell. I wouldn't even tell Fifth Sister-in-Law. She would be sure to blame me. But first, Little Uncle, what are people saying about me?” “People? What people? I've heard only what Brother Five told me.” “What did he say?” How could Hu repeat such words as ‘wine overcomes restraint’? After considering, he answered, “Brother Five said Gu wasn't to blame.” Though discreetly phrased, the meaning was plain to her. “Naturally, the blame is mine! As though I'd made myself cheap. Heaven is my witness—nothing of the sort happened!” “What didn't happen?” Hu asked in astonishment.

zh: 这一问，即令是七姑奶奶那样口没遮拦的人，也不由得脸生红晕，她正一正脸色，敛眉低眼答道：“小爷叔是我长辈，说出来也不碍口，到今天为止，老古没有碰过我的身子。”“原来是这回事！”胡雪岩越觉困惑，“那么，‘那回事’是怎么来的呢？”“是我赖老古的。”“为啥？”“为啥！”七姑奶奶这时才扬起脸来，“难道连小爷叔你这样子的‘光棍玲珑心’都不懂？”想一想也就懂了。必是七姑奶奶怕古应春变卦，故意灌醉了他，赖他有了肌肤之亲，这样古应春为了责任和良心就不得不答应娶他了。这个手法是连胡雪岩都梦想不到的。七姑奶奶的行事，与一般妇女不同，也就在这个手法上充分显现了。想想她真是用心良苦，而敢于如此大胆地作破釜沉舟之计，也不能不佩服！不过，交情深厚，胡雪岩是真的当她亲妹妹看待，所以佩服以外，更多的是不满，“你真真想得出！”他说，“不要说五嫂，我也要埋怨你！老古是有良心的，他跟我说的话，真正叫正人君子、万一老古没有肩胛，你岂不是‘鞋子没有着，先倒落个样’？好好的人家，落这样一个名声在外面，你自己不在乎，害得五哥走出去，脸上都没有光彩。你倒想想看，划算不划算？”
en: Even a woman as free-spoken as the Seventh Lady blushed at that question. Composing her face and lowering her eyes, she replied, “You're my elder, Little Uncle, so there's no harm in telling you. To this day, Gu has never touched my body.” “So that's it!” Hu was more puzzled than ever. “Then where did ‘that affair’ come from?” “I made him believe he'd done it.” “Why?” “Why?” Now she raised her face. “Surely even that worldly, ingenious heart of yours can understand!” A little thought made it plain. She must have been afraid Gu would change his mind, deliberately made him drunk, and claimed that they had been intimate. His sense of duty and conscience would then oblige him to marry her. It was a stratagem Hu would never have dreamed of. How unlike other women she was showed fully in this device. She had gone to extraordinary lengths, and he could not help admiring the courage with which she had burned her boats. Yet their friendship was close; he truly regarded her as his own younger sister. More than admiration, he felt disapproval. “What an idea to have! Never mind Fifth Sister-in-Law—I blame you too. Gu has a conscience. What he told me showed him to be a true gentleman. But suppose he'd refused to shoulder the responsibility? Wouldn't you have got the reputation before getting the shoes, as they say? A respectable woman, with a story like that going about! You may not care, but you've made Brother Five lose face whenever he goes out. Think about it. Was it worth it?”

zh: 这句话说得七姑奶奶失悔不迭，异常不安，“啊哟哟！”她搓着手，吸着气说：“小爷叔，你提醒我了！我倒没有想到，会害五哥坍台！这！这怎么办呢？”她这副着急的神态，胡雪岩从来没有见过，于心大为不忍，赶紧想安慰她，但灵机一动，觉得七姑奶奶天不怕，地不怕，不受人劝，难得有这样的机会，正好抓住了给她一个“教训”。于是，他越发把脸板了起来，“七姐”，他的声音很平静，但也很冷峻，“不是我说一句，你做事只顾自己高兴，不想想人家。象这种自毁名节的做法，坏你们尤家的名声，想来老太爷老太太在地下也会痛心。你的脾气真要改改了。”提到父母，七姑奶奶的良心越受责备，涨红了脸，盈盈欲泪，只拿求取谅解和乞援的眼色看着胡雪岩。“女人总是女人！”胡雪岩换了恳切柔和的声音说： “女人能干要看地方，男人本性上做不到的事，女人做得到，这才是真正能干。如果你象男人那样子能干，只有嫁个没用的丈夫，才能显你的长处，不然，就决不会有好结果。为啥呢，一个有骨气的丈夫；样样事情好忍，就是不能容忍太太在外场上扎丈夫的面子！”
en: His words filled her with regret and agitation. “Oh dear!” She wrung her hands and drew in her breath. “You've reminded me, Little Uncle. I never thought I might make Brother Five lose face. What... what am I to do?” Hu had never seen her so anxious. He felt deeply sorry for her and was about to comfort her when another thought occurred to him. She feared neither heaven nor earth and would listen to no one. Here was a rare chance to teach her a lesson. He made his face sterner. “Seventh Sister,” he said, his voice quiet but cold, “you think only of pleasing yourself, never of other people. By damaging your own honour like this, you damage the You family's name. Your parents must grieve for it in their graves. You really must change your ways.” Mention of her parents stung her conscience still more. Her face flushed; tears trembled in her eyes. She could only look at him, pleading for understanding and help. Hu's voice softened into earnestness. “A woman is still a woman. Her ability must show in the right sphere. If she can do what a man by his nature cannot, that is real ability. If you're capable in exactly the way a man is, only a useless husband will let your strengths shine. Otherwise, it can never end well. Why? A husband with spirit may put up with almost anything, but never with a wife humiliating him in public.”

zh: 七姑奶奶不响，倒不是无话可说，只是觉得遇到的人总是夸她怎么能干，怎么能干，不是恭维她“女中丈夫”，就是说她比男人还管用，胡雪岩这话，她还是第一次听到，要好好的想一想，这一细想，就象吃橄榄那样，上口酸涩，回味弥甘，这多少年在场面上处处占上风，但私底下作为一个女人的苦处，只有自己知道。到那孤灯独对、衾寒枕单的时候，场面上“七姐、七姐”叫得好响的声音，一无用处，心里所想的是丈夫跟孩子，情愿烧饭洗衣裳，吃苦也有个名堂。“人有男女，就好比天地有阴阳，万物有刚柔，如果女人跟男人一样，那就是只阳不阴。只刚不柔，还成什么世界？再说，一对夫妻，都是阳刚的性子，怎么合得拢淘？七姐，你说我的话错不错？”指名问到，七姑奶奶自然不会再沉默，应声答道：“不错！小爷叔的话，我还是第一次听到，如果早有人跟我说这话，我也不会象现在这样子的脾气。”“现在改也还来得及。”胡雪岩也答得极快。“江山好改，本性难移。”七姑奶奶停了一下又说：“我试试看。”“对！只要你有决心，要争口气，一定改得掉。倘或改不掉……”胡雪岩有意不说下去。七姑奶奶当然要追问：“改不掉会怎么样呢？”“改不掉？我说句老实话，你还是不必嫁老古的好。嫁了他，性情也合不拢的。”
en: The Seventh Lady said nothing. It was not that she had no answer, but everyone she met praised her ability. They either called her a woman with a man's courage or said she was more useful than a man. This was the first time she had heard anything like Hu's words, and she needed to consider them carefully. The more she did, the more they resembled an olive: sour and astringent at first, increasingly sweet in the aftertaste. For years she had had the upper hand in public life, but only she knew her private suffering as a woman. Alone beside a solitary lamp, with cold bedding and an empty place beside her pillow, all those ringing cries of “Seventh Sister! Seventh Sister!” were useless. What she longed for was a husband and children. She would willingly cook and wash; at least her toil would have a purpose. “There are men and women just as heaven and earth have yin and yang, and all things have firmness and softness. If women were the same as men, there'd be yang without yin, firmness without softness. What sort of world would that be? And if both husband and wife have forceful, unyielding temperaments, how can they live in harmony? Seventh Sister, am I right?” Directly asked, she could no longer remain silent. “Yes. I've never heard this before. If someone had said it earlier, I wouldn't have developed such a temper.” “It's still not too late to change,” Hu replied at once. “Mountains and rivers are easier to alter than a person's nature.” She paused. “I'll try.” “Good. If you're determined and want to show what you can do, you can change. If you can't...” He deliberately stopped. Naturally, she asked, “What if I can't?” “Then, honestly, you'd better not marry Gu. Even if you did, your temperaments wouldn't agree.”

zh: 这句话她觉得说得过分，但不便争辩，只好不答。“你不相信我的话是不是？”“不是不相信小爷叔的话。”七姑奶奶抢着说，“老古也常来常住，他没有说过啥！”“我知道。”胡雪岩平静地答说，“一则，这时候大家要客客气气，二则，男女双方，没有做夫妻跟做了夫妻以后的想法会变的！老古着重你的是心好，脾气豪爽。你不要把你的长处，变成短处，要把你的短处改过，变成长处。“这两句话说得七姑奶奶佩服了：“小爷叔这两句话有学问，我要听！”“那就对了，你肯听我的话，我自然要插手管你的事。不然做媒人做得挨骂，何必去做？”胡雪岩接着又问：“七姐，我先问你，你肯不肯改姓？”“改姓？”七姑奶奶睁大了一双眼问：“改啥姓？为啥？”“这个姓，当然不辱没你。喔，”胡雪岩突然想起一件事，急急问道：“还有句要紧话要问你，古家那位老族长见过你没有？”“没有。他们古家什么人我也没有见过。”“那好！一定成功。准定用我这条瞒天过海之计。”
en: She thought this went too far, but could hardly argue and gave no answer. “You don't believe me, do you?” “It isn't that,” she hastened to say. “Gu comes often and spends plenty of time here. He's never said anything.” “I know,” Hu replied calmly. “For one thing, you're both being polite to each other at present. For another, men and women think differently before and after marriage. What Gu values in you is your good heart and frank, generous spirit. Don't turn your strengths into weaknesses. Turn your weaknesses into strengths.” This won her admiration. “There's wisdom in those words, Little Uncle. I'll listen.” “That's right. If you'll listen, naturally I'll concern myself with your affairs. Otherwise, why make a match only to be cursed for it?” He continued, “First tell me, Seventh Sister: would you be willing to change your surname?” Her eyes widened. “Change it? To what? Why?” “It certainly wouldn't disgrace you. Oh!” Something occurred to him, and he asked urgently, “There's another important question. Has the old Gu clan head ever seen you?” “No. I've never met anyone from their family.” “Then we're certain to succeed. We'll use my plan to carry you safely past him without his knowing.”

zh: 胡雪岩这一计，是让王有龄认七姑奶奶作妹妹，不说是义兄妹，所以要改姓王，古应春求亲要向王家去求，女家应允亲事。也由王有龄出面付庚贴。这一来，古家的老族长看在知府大老爷的面子上，就算真的晓得了实情，也不好意思不答应，何况既未谋面，要瞒住他也很容易。七姑奶奶笑得合不拢口，“小爷叔！”她说，“你真正是诸葛亮，就算古家的老头子是曹操，也是吃蹩在你千里。不过，”她忽然双眉微蹩，笑容渐敛，“王大老爷啥身分，我啥身分？怎么高攀得上？”“这你不用管，包在我身上。”“还有，”七姑奶奶又说，“五哥的意思不知道怎么样？”“为你好，五哥无有不答应的，这也包在我身上。”七姑奶奶凝神想了一会，通前彻后思量遍，没有啥行不通的，只有一点顾虑：自己象不象知府家的姑奶奶？这样一想，便又下了决心，“我一定要改一改！”她说，“要象个官家小姐！”“对！这才是真的。”
en: Hu's plan was to have Wang Youling acknowledge the Seventh Lady as his sister. They would not say that the relationship was adoptive, so she must take the surname Wang. Gu would propose marriage to the Wang family; the bride's family would consent, and Wang himself would present the document giving her birth details. Out of respect for a prefect, the old clan head would find it difficult to refuse even if he learned the truth. Since he had never met her, however, deceiving him would be easy. The Seventh Lady could scarcely stop smiling. “Little Uncle, you're a real Zhuge Liang! Even if that old Gu fellow were Cao Cao, he'd still be beaten by you. But...” Her brows drew together slightly, and her smile faded. “What is Prefect Wang's position, and what is mine? How could I presume to claim such a connection?” “Don't concern yourself with that. Leave it to me.” “There's also Brother Five. I don't know what he'll think.” “If it's for your good, there's no reason for him to refuse. Leave that to me too.” She considered the plan from beginning to end and could find no obstacle. Only one concern remained: could she pass for the lady of a prefect's family? This brought a fresh resolve. “I really will change,” she said. “I must look like a daughter of an official household.” “Exactly. Now you're in earnest.”

zh: 就在这时候，只听辘辘马车声，自远而近，七姑奶奶是听惯了这声音的，说一声，“老古回来了！”随即掀开窗帘凝望。胡雪岩也站起来看，只见暮霭中现出两条人影，隐约分辨得出，一个是古应春，一个是尤五。等上楼来一看，果然不错。古应春把一大包熏鹌鹑之类的野味交给七姑奶奶时，不由得凝神望了她一眼。“怎么样？”他看她眉目舒展，多少天来隐隐存在的郁悒，一扫而空，所以问道：“老胡出了什么好主意？”这一问，连尤五也是精神一振，双眼左右环视，从胡雪岩看到他妹妹脸上，显出渴望了解的神情。这使得七姑奶奶很感动。她一直以为尤五对自己的麻烦，不闻不问，也不常来看她，是故意冷淡的表示，内心相当不满，现在才知道他是如何关切！因此，反倒矜持慎重了，“请小爷叔告诉你们好了。”她说， “这件事要问五哥。”说完，翩然下楼，到厨房去了。于是，胡雪岩把他的办法，为他们说了一遍。古应春十分兴奋，而尤五则比较沉着，所表示的意见，也就是七姑奶奶所顾虑过的。“王大老爷跟你的交情，我是晓得的，一说一定成功。不过我们自己要照照镜子，就算高攀上了，王大老爷不嫌弃，旁人会说闲后。”“五哥，你说这话，我就不佩服了。”胡雪岩很率直地说，“你难道是那种怕旁人道长论短说闲话的人？”尤五面有愧色，“自己人，我说实话，”他说，“这两年我真的有点怕事。俗语道得好：“初出三年，天下去得，再走三年，寸步难行。‘我现在就常想到这两句话。”
en: Just then, the rumble of a carriage approached. She knew the sound. “Gu's back!” Lifting the curtain, she looked out. Hu rose to look too. Two figures appeared in the dusk, dimly recognizable as Gu and You. When they came upstairs, he saw that he was right. As Gu handed her a large parcel of smoked quail and other game, he could not help studying her face. Her expression was open and relaxed; the underlying gloom of so many days had vanished. “Well? What good idea has Hu found?” Even You brightened at the question, looking eagerly from Hu to his sister. She was moved. She had thought he deliberately neglected her troubles and rarely visited because he meant to show his displeasure. She had resented him deeply. Only now did she see how much he cared. She became more restrained and considerate. “Let Little Uncle tell you. We must ask Brother Five about this.” With that, she went lightly downstairs to the kitchen. Hu explained his plan. Gu was delighted; You remained more composed. His objection was the same as his sister's had been. “I know your friendship with Prefect Wang. One word from you is certain to settle it. But we must take a look in the mirror. Even if we claim such a grand connection and he doesn't disdain us, other people will gossip.” “Brother Five, I can't admire that remark,” Hu said frankly. “Are you the sort of man who fears what others say?” You looked ashamed. “Among ourselves, I'll tell the truth. These last two years, I really have become rather afraid of trouble. The proverb is right: ‘For your first three years abroad, you can go anywhere under heaven; after another three, you can scarcely take a step.’ I often think of that now.”

zh: 胡、古两人都不作声，因为不知道尤五这话中是不是有何所指？觉得以保持沉默为宜。“这不谈了。就照小爷叔的办法，我这里在礼节上应该如何预备，请小爷叔吩咐。”“这是小事。眼前我们先要替老古筹划，事情要这样做法，就算原来所谈的亲事，已经不成功，另起炉灶娶王家的小姐。这样子才装得象。”“对！”尤五又郑重其事地说：“有句话！我要请小爷叔告诉阿七，这里不能再住了，先回松江去。”提到这一层，胡雪岩突然想起一句话，对古应春笑道：“对不起！我要跟尤五哥讲个蛮有趣的笑话。”既是有趣的笑话，何不说来大家听听，偏要背着人去讲？可见这笑话与自己有关。不但古应春大感困扰，连尤五也觉得奇怪，等胡雪岩说了七姑奶奶所表明的心迹，他却真的笑了，笑声甚大，因为一小半是好笑，一大半是欣悦，自己妹子不管怎么样飞扬浮操，到底还是玉洁冰清的！“笑啥？”古应春真的忍不住了，走过来问道：“说来让我也笑笑。”尤五和胡雪岩都不答他的话，不约而同的对看了一眼，相互征询意见。“这话应该说明白它！”尤五很认真的说。要说当然该由胡雪岩来说，他把古应人拉到一边，揭破了七姑奶奶的秘密。
en: Hu and Gu remained silent. They did not know whether You had something particular in mind and thought it best to say nothing. “Enough of that. We'll follow Little Uncle's plan. Tell me what preparations courtesy requires of me.” “That's a small matter. First, we must plan for Gu. To carry this off, we must treat the previous marriage proposal as having failed and begin afresh with a daughter of the Wang family. Only then will it look convincing.” “Exactly.” You added solemnly, “One thing: please tell A’qi she must stop living here. She must go back to Songjiang first.” This reminded Hu of something. He smiled at Gu. “Forgive me. I must tell Brother Five a rather amusing story.” If it was amusing, why not let everyone hear it? Why tell it behind someone's back? Evidently it concerned Gu himself. He was bewildered, and You was puzzled too. But when Hu told You what his sister had confessed, he really did laugh, loudly. A small part was amusement; most was joy. Whatever her flightiness or recklessness, his sister had, after all, remained chaste. Gu could contain himself no longer. He came over. “What's so funny? Tell me, so I can laugh too.” Neither answered. Instead, they exchanged a glance, silently consulting each other. “He ought to be told,” You said firmly. Naturally, it fell to Hu to do the telling. He drew Gu aside and revealed the Seventh Lady's secret.

zh: “怪不得！”古应春失声而呼，心中有无比的宽慰，因为解消了他多少天来，只能存之于心愿，无法跟人去研究的一个疑团。那天五更梦醒，只见七姑奶奶穿一件小夹袄在灯下独坐，眼下隐隐泪痕，然后就说，什么都给他了，要他对着灯起誓，永不变心。他也真的觉得愧对佳人，所以唯命是从。但有时静中回想，怎么样也记不起那般“软玉温香抱满怀”的旖旎风光，更不用说真个消魂，是何滋味？人生最难得的良宵，竟这样胡里胡涂、不知不觉地度过，真比“猪八戒吃人参果”还可惜。此刻才知道“猪八戒”是受了骗了。然而受骗比不曾受骗好！古应春非七姑奶奶不娶，主要的是为了尽责任，此刻却又恢复到初见时心境，“整顿全神注定卿”，是倾心爱慕，因而又向胡雪岩深深一揖：“务期玉成，越快越好！”“好事多磨，你把心耐下来。”胡雪岩揉一揉肚子说：“我实在饿了。”
en: “No wonder!” Gu exclaimed, immensely relieved. A mystery he had carried for days, unable to discuss it with anyone, was solved. When he had awoken towards dawn that night, he had found her sitting alone by the lamp in a light lined jacket, faint traces of tears beneath her eyes. She had told him that she had given him everything and made him swear before the lamp never to change his heart. Feeling that he had wronged her, he had done whatever she asked. Yet sometimes, in quiet reflection, he could recall nothing of that enchanting scene—her soft, warm, fragrant body in his arms—still less the rapture itself. To have passed one of life's rarest nights so muddled and unaware seemed more regrettable than Pigsy swallowing the ginseng fruit without tasting it. Only now did he learn that ‘Pigsy’ had been deceived. But being deceived was better than not being deceived. Until now, his determination to marry no one but the Seventh Lady had chiefly rested on duty. Now his feelings returned to those of their first meeting: all his attention fixed upon her, his whole heart devoted to her. He bowed deeply to Hu again. “You must bring this about—as quickly as possible!” “Good things meet many obstacles. Be patient.” Hu rubbed his stomach. “I'm really hungry.”

zh: 这一说，尤五和古应春都有同感，不知道女主人在做什么费手脚的菜，一直不能开饭？正想下楼探望，只见七姑奶奶带着小大姐，端了朱漆托盘上来，一进门就笑道：“今天吃广东鱼生。我是第一次做，不晓得灵光不灵光？如果不好吃，你们骂老古，是他传授得不得法。““你是第一次做，我是第一次见。怎么个吃法？”胡雪岩一面说，一面走过去看，中间是个空的盛鱼翅的大冰盘，另外又有十几个大大小小的盘子，盛着鱼生、榨得干干的萝卜丝、油炸过的粉丝与馓子、盐、糖、麻油、胡椒之类的作料，另有一碟切得其细如发的绿色丝子，他可看不出是什么东西了。“是橘树叶子，当香料用的。”七姑奶奶说，“要切得细，费了我好大的工夫。”这样一个豪放不拘细节的“女张飞”，能静下心来花样的细功夫，胡雪岩颇为惊异，同时也相当感动，不由得就说了声：“真难为你！”“先不要恭维我，尝了味道再说。”于是四个人一起动手，将所有的作料都倾入大冰盘，搅拌匀了，胡雪岩夹一筷送入口中，果然别有风味。“拿酒来！”好久不曾开口的尤五说，“今天要好好敬小爷叔几杯酒。”这一顿酒，喝得极其舒畅，胡雪岩成了“众矢之的”，三个人纷纷酬劝，喝到八分，吃了两碗鱼生及第粥，通体皆暖，乘兴说道：“五哥，我们去走走！”
en: You and Gu felt the same. What elaborate dish was their hostess making that kept dinner so long? They were about to go downstairs when she appeared with the maid, carrying red lacquer trays. “We're having Cantonese raw fish today,” she announced with a smile. “It's my first attempt, so I don't know whether it will work. If it tastes bad, blame Gu for teaching me badly.” “It's your first time making it, and my first time seeing it. How does one eat it?” Hu went over to look. In the centre was an empty large platter of the sort used for shark's fin. Around it stood more than a dozen dishes of various sizes, holding raw fish, shredded radish squeezed quite dry, fried vermicelli, crisp fried dough strands, salt, sugar, sesame oil, pepper and other seasonings. One dish contained green threads sliced as fine as hair. He could not identify them. “Tangerine leaves, for flavour,” she said. “They have to be cut very fine. It took me a great deal of work.” Hu was surprised, and rather touched, that this ‘female Zhang Fei’, so bold and indifferent to details, could settle down to such painstaking work. “You've taken such trouble!” “Don't compliment me yet. Taste it first.” All four helped tip the ingredients into the large platter and mix them evenly. Hu took a mouthful with his chopsticks and found it had a distinctive flavour. “Bring the wine,” said You, who had been silent for some time. “We must drink Little Uncle's health properly today.” It was a thoroughly happy meal. Hu became everyone's target as the other three urged cup after cup upon him. Well on the way to drunkenness, he ate two bowls of raw-fish and jidi congee and felt warm all over. In high spirits, he said, “Brother Five, let's go out for a walk.”

zh: “你想到哪里去？”尤五问。“走着再说。”他们俩站了起来，古应春亦接踵而起，喊了声“七姐！”然后歉意地说：“老胡第一天到，我该陪陪他。”七姑奶奶听了胡雪岩的劝，性情变过了，这一变也不过方寸一念之间。她以前的想法是：男人有什么了不起！吃讲茶、讲斤头，没啥希奇，上刀山、下油锅，照样也不会皱一皱眉。而现在时刻提醒自己的是：我是个女人，好人家的女儿，还要高攀王府上去做官家小姐，总要拢出女人的样子来，不要让人家背后骂一句“强盗婆”！有了这样的想法，便觉得古应春的这句话，会让她五哥和胡雪岩误会她离不开未婚丈夫，所以不但害羞，而且生嗔。“小爷叔来了，你理当陪他，何必跟我来说？象是我管头管脚，拿你管得多么凶似地。真正气数！”说完，还白了他一眼。七姑奶奶的美，就在宜喜宜嗔，白眼也象青眼，而且讲话也台道理，所以古应春被骂了还是心悦诚服。
en: “Where do you want to go?” “We'll decide as we walk.” They rose, and Gu followed. “Seventh Sister,” he said apologetically, “it's Hu's first day here. I ought to keep him company.” After listening to Hu's advice, she had changed her attitude—a change requiring no more than a turn of thought. She had once told herself: What is so remarkable about men? Settling disputes over tea or arguing a case was nothing special. Even a mountain of knives or a cauldron of boiling oil would not make her frown. Now she kept reminding herself: I am a woman, a daughter of a respectable family. I am to claim kinship with the Wangs and become a daughter of an official household. I must show a woman's manner and not let people call me a bandit woman behind my back. With such thoughts in mind, Gu's remark seemed likely to make her brother and Hu think that she could not bear to part with her future husband. She felt both shy and annoyed. “Little Uncle has come, so naturally you should accompany him. Why tell me? As though I watched your every move and kept you under such fierce control! How exasperating!” She gave him a sidelong glare. Her charm lay in looking equally lovely pleased or displeased. Even a hostile glance seemed affectionate, and what she said was reasonable. Gu accepted his scolding with a willing heart.

zh: 倒是胡雪岩反而拦住古应春，他是给他们方便，料知在这事有转机，难题将可解消的时候，他们俩必有一番款款深谈，但如果这样说，即使古应春肯留下，七姑奶奶也不会答应，所以他只往自己这方面找理由。“老古，不必！我跟五哥有几句话要说，你不必陪我。”“那么，”古应春踌躇着问道：“你们在哪里？我回头来寻你们。”“这样，”尤五向胡雪岩说，“我们到老二那里去坐一坐。”
en: It was Hu who stopped him. He wanted to give them time together. With their affairs taking a favourable turn and their difficulties near resolution, they must have much to say to each other tenderly. But if he said so, even if Gu agreed to stay, she would refuse. He therefore found a reason of his own. “No need, Old Gu. Brother Five and I have a few things to discuss. You needn't accompany us.” “Then where will you be?” Gu asked hesitantly. “I'll come and find you later.” You turned to Hu. “Let's go and sit with Second Miss.”

zh: 约定了地方，尤五陪着胡雪岩安步当车，到了怡情院。怡情老二出堂差去了，新用的一个娘姨阿巧姐十分能干，一面应酬着把客人引入大房间，一面派“相帮”去催怡情老二回来。“怎么玩法？”尤五问道，“是邀人来吃酒，还是打牌？”“打牌不必了。”胡雪岩看那阿巧姐白净俏刮，一口吴侬软语，比怡情老二说得还道地，大有好感，所以自告奋勇，“我来做个‘花头’。摆个‘双台’吧！”“胡老爷有多少客人？”阿巧姐说：“客人少了，摆双台不象呢。”“摆双台”不一定摆两桌，她这样说是表示当客人“自己人”，替他节省，胡雪岩对花丛的规矩还不大在行，不知如何回答？尤五却懂她的意思，同时料知胡雪岩一时不会有什么客人要请！便老实说道：“阿巧姐的话不错！要做花头，有的是辰光。等老二来了再说。“阿巧姐也附和着，胡雪岩只好作昙。两个人在套房里，隔着一只烟盘，躺在红木炕床上闲谈着，等候怡情老二。“这个陈巧娘姨倒还不错。”胡雪岩说，“今年快三十岁了吧？”“怎么样？”尤五笑道：“我替你做个媒，好不好？”
en: Their meeting place arranged, You accompanied Hu on foot to Yiqing House. Second Miss had gone out to entertain at a banquet. A capable newly hired house attendant, A’qiao, welcomed them, conducted them into the main room, and sent a male attendant to hurry Second Miss back. “How shall we amuse ourselves?” You asked. “Invite people to drink, or play cards?” “No need for cards.” Hu found A’qiao fair, neat and pretty. Her soft Wu speech was even more authentic than Second Miss's, and he took a strong liking to her. He volunteered a proposal. “I'll provide a little excitement. Let's arrange a double-table party.” “How many guests have you invited, Mr Hu?” A’qiao asked. “A double-table party won't look right with too few.” Such a party did not necessarily require two actual tables. Her remark showed that she treated him as one of the household and wanted to save him expense. Hu was not yet familiar with the customs of courtesan society and did not know how to reply. You understood her intention, and guessed that Hu had no guests ready to invite. He spoke frankly. “Sister A’qiao is right. There's plenty of time for a special entertainment. Let's wait until Second Miss comes.” A’qiao agreed, and Hu had to let the matter rest. In the inner room, the two men reclined on a rosewood couch, an opium tray between them, talking while they waited. “This attendant A’qiao is rather good,” Hu said. “She must be nearly thirty?” “Well?” You laughed. “Shall I make a match for you?”

zh: 胡雪岩笑而不答，自是默许之意，正想开口说什么，只见门帘掀处，怡情老二翩然出现，见了胡雪岩少不得有一番殷勤的问讯。接着，古应春也到了，他要抢着作东，北里冶游，有套不成文的法则，作主人必在相好的地方，吃了这家到那家，名为“翻台”，古应春为了生意上交际的需要，有个相熟的户头，名叫“虹影楼老七”，就在前一条弄堂“铺房间”，约胡雪岩先到那里吃一台酒，再翻回来在怡情院吃消夜。“没有这个规矩。”怡情老二反对，“自然是先在这里摆酒，再翻到虹影楼去。”。胡雪岩也认为应该这样，但尤五另有打算，摇手说道：“照老古的办法。回头来吃消夜。小爷叔不回丝栈了，今天晚上在你们这里‘借干铺’。“既然如此，当然是先到别处吃花酒，最后回到怡情院，吃完消夜，就可安歇，不必再挪动了。所以怡情老二点头同意，而且打算着陪尤五住到“小房子”去，将自己在怡情院的房间，让给胡雪岩住。
en: Hu smiled without answering, giving his tacit consent. He was about to say something when the curtain lifted and Second Miss appeared gracefully. Naturally, she greeted him with attentive inquiries. Gu arrived soon afterwards and insisted on playing host. Courtesan entertainment had its unwritten rules: one entertained at the establishment of one's own favourite, and going from a feast at one house to another was called ‘turning tables’. For the sake of business sociability, Gu had an established acquaintance, Seventh Miss of Hongying House, whose rooms were in the next lane. He invited Hu to dine there first, then return to Yiqing House for a late supper. “That isn't the rule,” Second Miss objected. “Naturally, you should dine here first and then move to Hongying House.” Hu agreed, but You had another plan. He waved his hand. “Let's do as Gu suggests and come back for supper. Little Uncle isn't returning to the silk warehouse. He'll borrow an empty bed here tonight.” In that case, it made sense to enjoy the courtesan banquet elsewhere and return to Yiqing House last. After supper, Hu could rest without moving again. Second Miss agreed. She planned to stay with You at their small separate house and leave her own rooms at Yiqing House for Hu.

zh: 于是一起到了虹影楼，进门落座，古应春就叫取纸笔写请客票。胡雪岩征尘甫卸，惮于应酬之繁，便阻止他说：“算了，算了！就我们三个人玩玩吧！”这一来改了写局票，第一张是怡情老二，写完了，古应春拈笔问胡雪岩，“小爷叔，”他改了称呼，“叫哪个？是不是以前的那个眉香老四？”“市面勿灵！”虹影楼老七接口，“眉香老四上一节就不做了。”“这样吧，”尤五代为做主，向古应春说道：“你们做个‘联襟’吧，叫老九来陪小爷叔。”“老九？”古应春说，“老九是‘清倌人’！”虹影楼老九是只以歌艺陪客的“清倌人”。古应春的意思是提醒尤五，胡雪岩如果叫“虹影楼老九”的局，只能欣赏她的歌艺，而胡雪岩却了解尤五的用心，赶紧说道：“就是清倌人好。”这一说，主随客意，古应春便把局票发了出去，一个在楼上，一个隔一条弄堂，不费工夫，所以等席面摆好，怡情老二和虹影楼老九都到了，各人跟着一名提了胡琴的“乌师”，准备清唱下酒。
en: They went together to Hongying House. As soon as they were seated, Gu called for paper and brush to write invitations. Hu, scarcely recovered from his journey and reluctant to face elaborate sociability, stopped him. “No, no. Let the three of us enjoy ourselves.” Instead, Gu wrote summonses for the entertainers. The first was for Second Miss. Holding his brush, he asked Hu, adopting a different form of address, “Little Uncle, whom shall we call? Fourth Miss of Meixiang House, as before?” “Business is poor,” Seventh Miss put in. “Fourth Miss left the profession at the last festival.” You decided for Hu. “Why don't you two become ‘brothers-in-law’? Call Ninth Miss to keep Little Uncle company.” “Ninth Miss?” Gu said. “She's a qingguan.” Ninth Miss of Hongying House was a qingguan, a young performer who entertained guests through her singing. Gu was reminding You that if Hu summoned her, he could only enjoy her performance. Hu, however, understood You's intention and quickly said, “A qingguan is just what I want.” The host deferred to his guest and sent out the summonses. One performer was upstairs and the other only a lane away, so no time was lost. By the time the table was laid, Second Miss and Ninth Miss had arrived, each accompanied by a musician carrying a huqin, ready to sing without theatrical costume as the men drank.

adaptation.reason: 18023明确老九十五岁；仅将18017涉及未成年人的性接待资格解释改为歌艺陪客，保留清倌身份、邀客与演唱安排。

zh: 席面甚宽，“小姐”不必按规矩坐在客人身后，夹杂并坐，胡雪岩拉青虹影楼老九细看，见她刘海覆额，稚气未脱，便问：“你今年几岁？”“十五。”胡雪岩看一看虹影楼老七，再回脸看她，一个鸭蛋脸，一个圆脸，面貌神情，完全两路，因又问道：“你们是不是亲姐妹？”问到这话，虹影楼老九笑而不答，古应春接口说道：“哪里来这么多亲姐妹？不过，老九的事，老七做得了主。”胡雪岩懂他的意思，但并无另外安排的打算，就不接口了。“老九！”古应春就，“你唱一段什么？”“胡老爷喜欢听啥，我就唱啥。”“唷！”胡雪岩笑道，“看样子老九肚里的货色还不少。”“不错！”古应春说，“女大十八变，她现在年纪还小，论艺，将来一定行。”“谢谢你。姐夫！”虹影楼老九嫣然一笑，现在两个酒窝，显得很甜。“将来一定会更出色，值得在技艺上下功夫培养。”“全靠胡老爷捧场。”虹影楼老七，接着胡雪岩的话说，然后又轻声去问古应春，他住在哪里？
en: The table was spacious enough for the women to sit among the guests instead of behind them, as custom otherwise required. Hu drew Ninth Miss nearer for a look. Her fringe covered her forehead, and she still had a child's air. “How old are you?” “Fifteen.” Hu looked from Seventh Miss back to her. One had an oval face, the other a round one; their looks and expressions were wholly different. “Are you actual sisters?” Ninth Miss smiled without answering. Gu replied, “Where would so many actual sisters come from? But Seventh Miss can make decisions for her.” Hu understood, but had no intention of arranging anything further and let the matter drop. “Ninth Miss,” Gu said, “what will you sing?” “Whatever Mr Hu would like to hear.” “Oh!” Hu smiled. “It seems you have quite a repertoire.” “Indeed. Girls change greatly as they grow up, and she's still very young. As for her art, she's certain to do well.” “Thank you, Brother-in-Law.” Ninth Miss smiled, showing two dimples that made her look sweet. “She'll certainly grow more accomplished. Her talents are worth cultivating.” “She'll depend on your support, Mr Hu,” Seventh Miss answered. Then she quietly asked Gu where Hu was staying.

zh: “你问这话做啥？”古应春笑道：“是不是担心胡老爷没安排好住处？”“狗嘴里长不出象牙！”虹影楼老七，捏起粉拳在他背上捶了一下，“我跟你说！”说得很轻，咕咕噜噜听不清什么，尤五有些不耐烦，大声说道：“有话不会到枕头上去说！吃酒！吃酒。”虹影楼老七见客人发话，急忙赔笑道歉，亲自执壶敬酒，又叫她妹妹唱了一段小调，这才把席面槁得热闹了起来。一曲既罢，来了张局票，交到虹影楼老九手里，她说一声：“对不起！回头请过来会。“起身而去，这一下席面顿时又显得冷清清了。尤五大为不满，“凳子都没有坐热，就要转局。”他说，“这种花酒吃得真没有味道！”这一说，虹影楼老七自然不安，说好话，赔不是。尤五爱理不理，胡雪岩懒得答话，一时场面上弄得很尴尬，虹影楼老七面子上有些下不来，便嗔怪古应春不开口帮她，是存心要她的好看。“我不怪你，你还怪我！”古应春也有些光火。“好了，好了！”怡情老二开口相劝，“都看我的薄面，七阿姐决不敢故意怠慢贵客的。”一面说，一面将尤五拉了一把。
en: “Why do you ask?” Gu said with a smile. “Are you worried that Mr Hu hasn't arranged somewhere to stay?” “No ivory ever comes out of a dog's mouth!” Seventh Miss made a little fist and tapped him on the back. “Let me tell you...” She spoke so softly that the others could not make out her murmuring. You grew impatient. “Can't you save your private talk for the pillow? Drink! Drink!” Seeing that a guest was displeased, Seventh Miss hastily smiled and apologized. She took the wine pot herself to serve them and had her younger sister sing a popular tune. Only then did the table become lively. As soon as the song ended, another summons arrived for Ninth Miss. “Forgive me. Please come and see me later,” she said, rising to leave. The company immediately seemed subdued again. You was deeply displeased. “She hadn't even warmed her seat before moving on to another party. There's no pleasure in a banquet like this.” Naturally uneasy, Seventh Miss tried soothing words and apologies. You scarcely acknowledged her, while Hu could not be bothered to answer. The atmosphere became awkward. Unable to maintain her dignity, she reproached Gu for saying nothing in her support, as though he wanted to see her humiliated. “I haven't blamed you, and now you're blaming me!” Gu, too, was becoming angry. “Now, now,” Second Miss intervened. “For my sake, please. Seventh Sister would never deliberately neglect honoured guests.” As she spoke, she tugged at You.

zh: 这个不曾开口，胡雪岩倒觉得老大过意不去，“都怪我！”他举杯向古、尤二人说道，“罚我一杯。”这罚的是什么名堂？古应春正想发问，胡雪岩抛过一个眼色来，暗示息事宁人，倒使得他越觉歉然，想了想，对怡情老二说道：“到你那里去吧！”“这，怎么好意思！”怡情老二为了“小姐妹”的义气，面有难色。“这里很好！”胡雪岩故意说道：“老七，请你拿块热手巾给我。”等她一走，胡雪岩便劝告古应春和尤五，逢场作戏，不必认真。那两个没有表示，怡情老二却大为感动，说他脾气好，能体谅人，不知道哪个福气的，做着这一号好客人。这一说提醒了尤五，把她拉到一边，附耳低语，怡情老二一双俏眼，只瞟着胡雪岩，一面听，一面点头，最后说了句：“包在我身上。”“听见没有？”尤五笑道，“包在老二身上。”胡雪岩会意，报以感谢的一笑，古应春却不明白，但察言观色，料知是一桩有趣的事，而这桩趣事，决不会发生在虹影楼，便站起身来说，“走吧！”这一走，让虹影楼老七的面子过不去，怡情老二和胡雪岩便都相劝，总算又坐了下来，但意兴已颇阑珊。
en: You said nothing, but Hu felt thoroughly uncomfortable. “It's all my fault,” he said, raising his cup to Gu and You. “I'll drink a penalty cup.” What was the penalty for? Gu was about to ask when Hu gave him a look urging him to let the matter rest. This only made Gu more apologetic. After considering, he said to Second Miss, “Let's go to your place.” “How could I?” She looked troubled, out of loyalty to her fellow courtesan. “We're very comfortable here,” Hu said deliberately. “Seventh Miss, would you bring me a hot towel?” Once she had gone, he advised Gu and You not to take a passing entertainment so seriously. Neither answered, but Second Miss was deeply moved. He was so good-tempered and considerate, she said; what fortunate woman would have such a patron! This reminded You of something. He drew her aside and whispered in her ear. Her bright eyes kept glancing at Hu as she listened and nodded. At last she said, “Leave it to me.” “Did you hear?” You laughed. “Second Miss has it in hand.” Understanding, Hu returned a grateful smile. Gu did not understand, but their expressions suggested an amusing development, and one that certainly would not occur at Hongying House. He rose. “Let's go.” To leave like this would embarrass Seventh Miss, so both Hu and Second Miss persuaded him to stay. He sat down again at last, but their pleasure was nearly spent.

zh: 勉强坐到钟敲十下，才算终席。等回到怡情老二的小房子里，不曾再摆酒，煮茗清谈，反倒有良朋聚首之乐。胡雪岩便讲他在湖州的遭遇，与刘不才的妙闻。尤五听了，只觉得有趣，古应春却是别有会心。“这位刘老兄倒是难得的人才。”他说：“能不能叫他到上海来？”“当然可以。”胡雪岩问：“莫非你有用他之处？”“对！这个人是‘篦片’的好材料。”古应春说，“十里夷场，光怪陆离，就要这样的人，才有办法。我想请他专门来替我们陪客，贵家公子，纨袴子弟，还有些官场红员，都喜欢到夷场上来见识见识，有个人能陪着他们玩，说什么话都容易了。“这个看法与胡雪岩相近，因而欣然同意，决定第二天就写信把刘不才找来。
en: They endured until the clock struck ten, when the feast could finally end. Back at Second Miss's small separate house, they served no further wine. Over tea and quiet conversation, they found instead the pleasure of good friends gathered together. Hu told them about his experiences in Huzhou and Liu Bucai's amusing exploits. You simply found the stories entertaining; Gu saw a further significance. “This Mr Liu is a rare talent. Could he be brought to Shanghai?” “Certainly. Have you a use for him?” “Yes. He would make an excellent professional companion to guests. This ten-mile foreign settlement is full of extraordinary sights; it takes just such a man to find his way about. I'd like him to do nothing but entertain our visitors. Sons of great families, pampered young gentlemen and influential officials all like to see something of the foreign settlement. If someone can keep them amused, everything becomes easier to discuss.” His view was close to Hu's own. Hu readily agreed and decided to write for Liu the following day.

zh: 接下来又是大谈生意，古应春的主意很多，从开戏馆到买地皮，无不讲得头头是道。但所有的生意，都寄托在上海一定会繁荣这个基础上，而要上海繁荣，首先要设法使上海安定。夷场虽不受战火的影响，但有小刀会占领县城，总是肘腋之患。同时江苏官方跟洋人在暗中较劲，阻隔商贩，夷场的市面，也要大受影响。这样联想下来，胡雪岩便有了一个新的看法。“老古，”他说，“我看我那票丝，还是趁早脱手的好。”“怎么？”古应春很注意地问：“你是怎么想了想？”“我在想，禁止丝茶运到上海，这件事不会太长久的。搞下去两败俱伤，洋人固然受窘，上海的市面也要萧条。我们的做法，应该在从中转圜，把彼此不睦的原因拿掉，叫官场相信洋人，洋人相信官场，这样子才能把上海弄热闹起来。那时开戏馆也好，买地皮也好，无往不利，你们说，我这话对不对？”
en: They went on to talk business at length. Gu had ideas for everything from opening a theatre to buying land, and explained them all persuasively. Yet every venture rested on Shanghai's future prosperity, and prosperity first required stability. Though the foreign settlement escaped the fighting, the Small Swords Society's occupation of the county town remained a danger close at hand. Meanwhile, the Jiangsu authorities were quietly contending with the foreigners and obstructing traders, which would seriously damage the settlement's market. Following this train of thought, Hu reached a new conclusion. “Old Gu, I think I'd better sell that consignment of silk soon.” “Why?” Gu asked attentively. “What's led you to that view?” “The ban on sending silk and tea to Shanghai cannot last long. If it continues, both sides will suffer. The foreigners will be in difficulty, certainly, but Shanghai's trade will also decline. We ought to mediate and remove the causes of their hostility, so that officials trust the foreigners and foreigners trust the officials. Only then can Shanghai flourish. At that point, whether we open a theatre or buy land, everything will prosper. Am I right?”

zh: 古尤二人，都深深点头，“小爷叔，”古应春不胜倾服地说，“你看得深了！做大生意就要这样。帮官场的忙，就等于帮自己的忙。现在督、扰两衙门，都恨英国人接济刘丽川。这件事有点弄僵了，仿佛斗气的样子，其实两方面都在懊悔，拿中国官场来说，如果真的断了洋商的生路，起码关税就要少收。所以禁制之举，也实在叫万不得已。如果从中有人出来调停，就此言归于好，不是办不到的事。不过说来说去是一介商人，洋人那里是很看得起商人的，一定说得上话，就是我们自己官场里，这条线不知怎么样搭法？”“有条路子，我看可以试试。”尤五慢吞吞的说道：“何学台那里！”“对，对！”古应春说，“这条路子好！何学台虽然管的是考秀才，也常常上奏折讲江苏军务的，我看能见他一面，一定有些好处。”
en: Gu and You nodded gravely. “Little Uncle, you've seen further,” Gu said with deep admiration. “That is how to do great business. Helping the authorities is helping ourselves. At present, both the governor-general's and the governor's yamens resent the British for supplying Liu Lichuan. They've reached something of a deadlock, almost a contest of temper. In fact, both sides regret it. The Chinese authorities, for instance, would at least lose customs revenue if they really cut off the foreign merchants' livelihood. The restrictions are a last resort. If someone mediated, a reconciliation would by no means be impossible. But when all is said and done, we're merely merchants. Foreigners respect merchants, so we can certainly make ourselves heard there. The difficulty is how to make contact with our own officials.” You spoke slowly. “There's one avenue we might try: Provincial Education Commissioner He.” “Exactly!” Gu agreed. “An excellent avenue. Though his work concerns the licentiate examinations, he often submits memorials on military affairs in Jiangsu. A meeting with him is sure to help.”

zh: “要见他也容易，不过请王大老爷写信引见，费些周折。”胡雪岩想了想说，“我看这样，索性你自己去一趟，当面投王大老爷的那封信，不就见着了吗？”这件事如果能做成功，古应春的声名，立刻便可大起，所以他颇有跃跃欲试之意，欣然接纳了胡雪岩的建议。只是贸贸然跑了去，空谈无益，总得先在英国领事那里作个接触，探明意向，估量有没有谈得拢的可能，才好下手。这一来，就不是三两天的事了。“这封信也是要紧的。”古应春决定多吃一趟辛苦，“我先去走一趟，认识了何学台，见机行事，一方面仍旧请小爷叔写信给王大老爷，请他出一封荐函来，备而不用。”“都随你。那封荐函上怎么说法，你索性起个稿子，我寄到湖州，请他抄一遍，盖印寄来，岂不省事？”
en: “Seeing him should be easy enough. But asking Prefect Wang for a letter of introduction will take some arranging.” Hu considered. “Then why don't you go yourself and deliver that letter from Prefect Wang in person? That would gain you a meeting.” If this undertaking succeeded, Gu's reputation would rise at once. Eager to try, he gladly accepted the suggestion. Yet rushing off with nothing but empty talk would serve no purpose. He must first contact the British consul, ascertain his intentions and judge whether agreement was possible. Only then could he act. This meant the matter would take more than two or three days. “The letter is urgent too,” Gu said, deciding to undertake an extra journey. “I'll go first, make Commissioner He's acquaintance and act as the opportunity offers. Meanwhile, please write to Prefect Wang for a letter recommending me, so we have it ready even if we don't need it.” “As you wish. Why not draft the recommendation yourself? I'll send it to Huzhou and ask him to copy it, affix his seal and return it. Wouldn't that save trouble?”

zh: 兴致勃勃的古应春，当时便要动笔，尤五看时过午夜，不愿误了胡雪岩的良宵、因而劝阻，说等明天再办也不迟。接着，便跟怡情老二一起伴着胡雪岩去“借干铺”。“今天实在怠慢，”古应春歉意地说，“虹影楼那顿酒扫兴之至。老七还要托我请你捧场，真正不识相。”“那也无所谓。”胡雪岩说，“反正花几个钱的事。我也要有个地方好约朋友去坐，就做了那个清倌人吧！”“算了，小爷叔！”尤五说道，“我劝你象我这样子也蛮好。”这句话古应春不甚明白，胡雪岩却懂，如果对阿巧姐中意，不妨也借一处小房子。湖州立了个门户已经在打饥荒了，何苦再惹一处麻烦？不过当着怡情老二，不便明言拒绝，只好敷衍着说：“再看吧！”
en: Full of enthusiasm, Gu was ready to take up his brush at once. You saw that it was past midnight and did not wish to spoil Hu's pleasant night. He stopped Gu, saying tomorrow would be soon enough. Then he and Second Miss accompanied Hu to his borrowed bed. “We've really neglected you today,” Gu said apologetically. “That dinner at Hongying House was thoroughly disappointing. Seventh Miss even wanted me to ask for your patronage. She has no sense of occasion.” “It doesn't matter,” Hu replied. “It's only a matter of spending a little money. I need somewhere to meet friends as well. I might as well become that young singer's patron.” “Forget it, Little Uncle,” You said. “I'd advise you to do as I do. It works very well.” Gu did not quite understand, but Hu did. If A’qiao pleased him, he might rent a small separate house too. Establishing a household in Huzhou had already strained his funds. Why bring another burden upon himself? With Second Miss present, however, he could not refuse openly. He merely put the matter off. “We'll see.”
